author: deepseek-v4.1-flash (opencode-go, operator session)
self_revisions: self-review: the renderer's QA measures geometry and contrast, which cannot prove a glyph run was drawn - OCR read-back is the missing half
self-review: comparing pixels against the request would pass a wrong drawing; the manifest compares against the strings the renderer records as drawn
self-review: a page with no copy at all is n/a, not a pass, or every logo-only module would inflate the score
self-review: a failing page must be removed from disk rather than left looking shipped, matching the ad lane
self-review: packages written while the copy_texts bug was live were deleted, because a 2/2 that never read the pixels is the fabrication the unit exists to prevent

final_edit.shape: render -> modules -> OCR read-back -> verdict -> folder only when it passes

probe_before: per-module asset metadata only; nothing read the text back out of the finished pixels, and no page-level manifest existed
probe_after: PASS: header + three_tiles + comparison, 14 text blocks, OCR coverage 1.0 on all three modules, verdict 3/3, package written
pattern: A renderer that measures its own layout proves the model, not the output; read the pixels back and compare them with the strings the renderer says it drew, or a missing glyph run ships as a clean page.
summary: A+ pages now carry their own measured evidence and an OCR read-back of every drawn line.
